description: Searches Zillow for `location` (a city/state or ZIP) and returns the listings as JSON: `price`, `beds`, `baths`, `area`, `address`, `homeType`, `zestimate`, `rentZestimate`, `daysOnZillow`, coordinates, broker and a clean `url`. Filter with `status` (for_sale / for_rent / sold), `min_price`/`max_price`, `beds`, `baths` and `home_type`, sort with `sort`, and collect up to `max_results` across pages. Rental results can include apartment buildings (`isBuilding: true`): they have no `zpid` and carry `lotId`, `buildingName`, a rent range (`price` to `maxPrice`), `units` and `availableUnits` instead. Returns JSON. Billed like an API request; listing plugins bill one unit per result page they fetch, so keep max_results modest.

home_type.description: Property type filter: houses, condos, townhomes, multi_family, apartments, manufactured, lots_land. Omit for all.

location.description: City/state or ZIP to search, e.g. 'Austin, TX' or '78704'.

max_results.description: How many listings to collect across pages (~41 per page). Default: 41.

page.description: 1-based results page to start from. Default: 1.

proxy_country.description: Proxy country the request is sent from (ISO-2, e.g. 'US', 'DE'). Defaults to US.

sort.description: Ordering: newest, price_asc, price_desc, relevant, beds, sqft, lot. Default: newest.

status.description: Listing status: for_sale, for_rent, sold. Default: for_sale.

name: zillow_search
title: Scrape Zillow real-estate listings
